title: Minecraft Damage (Oof)
blurb: Blunt, dusty and completely unchanged for well over a decade: the grunt of a Minecraft player taking a hit. It carries no drama whatsoever, which is exactly why it is funny — fall damage, drowning and a zombie to the back of the head all receive the same weary acknowledgement. Alongside the Roblox oof it forms the sacred duo of blocky-game pain sounds, and both travel far beyond gaming. A stubbed toe, a roast landing squarely, a bank balance checked at the wrong hour of the month: same sound, same shrug, same faint sense of having deserved it.
origin: The classic player-damage grunt from Minecraft.
